MAS-COMPLEXITY-BENCH: A Scalable Benchmark Generator for Multi-Agent Collaboration
	


MAS-COMPLEXITY-BENCH is a powerful Python-based benchmark generator designed to create a diverse suite of tasks for evaluating Multi-Agent Systems (MAS).
Unlike static benchmarks, this tool generates test cases on-demand, allowing researchers to precisely control key parameters:

Agent Count (n): The number of collaborating agents.
Task Redundancy (m): The number of test cases to generate for each… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/BarryJJ666/MAS-communication-benchmark.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark generator for multi-agent communication with growing interest in MAS research but limited mainstream adoption so far.
